articles.title: Quick Start Guide
articles.summary: Get started with LANA AI in just a few steps
articles.content:
## Quick Start Guide

Welcome to LANA AI! Here's how to get started quickly.

### Step 1: Connect to Your Organization

When you first open LANA AI, you'll see a connection screen.

**What you need from your administrator:**
- Organization ID
- Your email address
- Activation code (for first-time users)

**How to connect:**
1. Type your **Organization ID** in the first box (your administrator will give you this)
2. The **Server URL** fills in automatically
3. Click **Connect**

**Note:** If you have connection problems, ask your administrator for help.

### Step 2: Activate Your Account (First Time Only)

If you haven't activated your account yet:

1. On the login screen, click **Activate here** (at the bottom)
2. Type your **activation code** (your administrator gave you this)
3. Type your **email address**
4. Create a new **password**:
   - At least 8 characters
   - Include uppercase and lowercase letters
   - Include numbers
   - Include special characters (like ! or @)
5. Type your password again to confirm
6. Click **Activate**

Your account is now ready to use!

### Step 3: Log In

1. Type your **email address**
2. Type your **password**
3. Check **Remember me** if you want to stay logged in (optional)
4. Click **Sign in**

**Forgot your password?** Click **Forgot password?** and follow the steps to reset it.

**Having trouble?** Contact your system administrator for help.

### Step 4: Set Up Your Profile

After logging in for the first time:

1. Click **Settings** in the menu
2. Click **Profile**
3. Add your name and contact information
4. Add a profile picture (optional)
5. Choose how you want to get notifications

### Step 5: Create Your First Case

1. Click **Matters** in the menu on the left
2. Click **New Matter**
3. Type in the case details:
   - Case name
   - Client name
   - Case type
4. Click **Create**

### Step 6: Add Documents

1. Open your new case
2. Click the **Upload** button
3. Choose files or drag and drop them
4. Wait for LANA AI to process them (this takes a few minutes)

### Step 7: Ask Questions

Go to the **Chat** page and ask LANA AI questions about your files!

**Example questions:**
- "Summarize the Smith contract"
- "What are the payment terms?"
- "Find all mentions of deadlines"

**What's Next:**
- Connect to SharePoint or Google Drive to sync files automatically
- Set up workflows to automate tasks
- Invite team members to work with you

articles.title: Your First Login
articles.summary: What to expect when you first log in
articles.content:
## Your First Login

Here's what happens when you first use LANA AI:

### Step 1: Connect to Your Organization

When you open LANA AI, you'll see a connection screen.

**What you need:**
Your administrator will give you:
- Organization ID (example: your-organization-id)
- Your email address
- Activation code (for first-time users)

**How to connect:**
1. Type your **Organization ID** in the box
2. The **Server URL** will fill in automatically (like your-org-id.lanaai.io)
3. Click **Connect**

**Can't connect?** 
- Check that you typed the Organization ID correctly
- Ask your administrator for help

### Step 2: Activate Your Account (First Time Only)

If you're a brand new user:

1. On the login screen, look at the bottom
2. Click **Activate here**
3. You'll see the activation screen

**Fill in the activation form:**
1. Type your **activation code** (your administrator gave you this)
2. Type your **email address**
3. Create a strong **password**:
   - At least 8 characters
   - Include uppercase and lowercase letters
   - Include numbers
   - Include special characters (like ! or @)
4. Type your password again to confirm
5. Click **Activate**

Your account is now active and ready to use!

### Step 3: Log In

After activation, or when you return:

1. Type your **email address**
2. Type your **password**
3. Check **Remember me** if you want to stay logged in (optional)
4. Click **Sign in**

**Forgot your password?**
Click **Forgot password?** and follow the instructions to reset it.

**Need help?**
Contact your system administrator if you have any problems.

### Step 4: What You'll See After Login

**The Main Page (Dashboard):**
- **Welcome message** with your name
- **Quick stats** showing your cases, files, and activity
- **Recent activity** - what's been happening
- **Quick actions** - buttons to create cases or upload files

**The Menu (on the left):**
- **Dashboard** - Overview page
- **Chat** - Ask the AI questions
- **Matters** - Your cases
- **Data Connectors** - Connect to SharePoint or Google Drive
- **Sync Status** - Check if connections are working
- **AI Insights** - See reports and statistics
- **Workflows** - Automate tasks
- **Help & Support** - Get help (you're here now!)

### Getting Help

If you need help:
- Click **Help & Support** in the menu
- Click the **?** icon for quick help
- Contact your system administrator
- Email support@redroostertec.com

articles.title: Using the Dashboard
articles.summary: Learn how to use the main page
articles.content:
## Using the Dashboard

The dashboard is your main page in LANA AI.

### Top Bar

- **Bell icon** - See new notifications
- **Your name** - Click to access settings or log out

### Stats Cards

- **Total Matters** - How many cases you have
- **Active Users** - Team members online (admins only)
- **Documents** - How many files are in the system
- **Storage Used** - How much space you're using

### Recent Activity

- See what your team has been doing
- Track file uploads and changes
- See AI usage

### System Status (Admins Only)

- Check if all services are working
- See database, AI, and storage health

### Shortcuts You Can Use

- Press **Ctrl+K** (Windows) or **Cmd+K** (Mac) for quick search
- Press **Ctrl+/** or **Cmd+/** to open help
- Press **Ctrl+,** or **Cmd+,** to open settings

### Customization

You can change your dashboard by:
- Choosing default views in Settings
- Picking which stats to show
- Setting up how you want notifications

articles.title: Using the Desktop App
articles.summary: How to access LANA AI on your computer
articles.content:
## Using the Desktop App

Most people use the desktop app to access LANA AI.

### Opening the App

**On Windows:**
Double-click the LANA AI icon on your desktop.

**On Mac:**
Double-click the LANA AI icon in your Applications folder.

**On Linux:**
Click the LANA AI icon in your programs menu.

### First Time Setup

When you first open the app:

1. **Automatic search** - The app tries to find the LANA AI computer in your office
2. **If found** - You go straight to the login screen
3. **If not found** - You'll need to type in the computer's address (ask your IT person)

### Desktop App Features

- **Auto-update** - The app updates itself automatically
- **System notifications** - Get alerts on your computer
- **Works offline** - Most features work even without internet
- **File sharing** - Easy drag and drop from your computer

### Web Browser Access (Optional)

Some people can also use a web browser:
- Type in `http://<computer-address>:8080` in your browser
- Supported browsers: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge
- You need to know the computer's address
- Ask your administrator if you need this

### Troubleshooting

**App can't find the computer:**
- Make sure you're on the office WiFi or network
- Ask your IT person for the computer address
- Check if your firewall is blocking it

**App won't open:**
- Restart your computer
- Reinstall the app
- Contact your administrator

articles.title: Using Chat
articles.summary: Learn how to talk to the AI
articles.content:
## Using Chat

The chat feature lets you ask questions about your files.

### Starting a Chat

1. Click **Chat** in the menu
2. Pick a case from the dropdown (this helps the AI know which files to use)
3. Type your question
4. Press Enter or click Send

### What You Can Ask

**About Files:**
- "What does the Smith contract say about payments?"
- "Summarize the lease agreement"
- "Find all mentions of deadlines"

**Compare Files:**
- "What changed between version 1 and version 2?"
- "How is this contract different from the template?"

**Draft Documents:**
- "Write a response letter to this complaint"
- "Create a summary of these meeting notes"

**Answer Questions:**
- "When is the project deadline?"
- "Who is responsible for maintenance?"

### File Drawer

Click the **file drawer icon** to:
- Choose specific files for the AI to read
- Upload new files to ask about
- See file information

### Chat History

All your chats are saved. You can:
- Look at old conversations
- Continue where you left off
- Export chats to save them

### Important Reminders

- **Be specific** - Give details about what you need
- **Pick the right case** - This helps the AI find the right files
- **Ask follow-up questions** - The AI remembers what you've been talking about
- **Always check answers** - The AI is a helper, not a replacement for your expertise

### When the AI Might Be Wrong

- It can't find the right files
- Your question isn't clear
- The answer needs complex legal analysis
- The files are missing information

Always use your professional judgment when using AI answers.

articles.title: Managing Cases
articles.content:
## Managing Cases

LANA AI uses "matters" (also called cases) to keep your work organized.

### Creating a Case

1. Click **Matters** in the menu
2. Click **New Matter**
3. Fill in:
   - Case name
   - Client name
   - Case type (like lawsuit, contract review, etc.)
   - Status (open, pending, closed)
   - Team members who can access it
4. Click **Create**

### Case Dashboard

Each case has:
- **Documents** - All files for this case
- **Activity** - Timeline of what happened
- **Team** - People assigned to work on it
- **Notes** - Comments and reminders
- **AI Insights** - Statistics and predictions

### Uploading Files

Inside a case:
1. Click **Upload Documents**
2. Choose files or drag and drop
3. Supported types: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images, and more
4. Wait for processing (this can take a few minutes)

### Organizing Files

**Folders:**
- Create folders to group related files
- Drag and drop files to move them

**Tags:**
- Add tags to label files
- Use our tags or create your own

**Search:**
- Search all text in files
- Filter by date, type, or tag

### Controlling Access

Choose who can see each case:
- Assign specific people to work on it
- Give them view-only or full access
- Admins can see all cases

### Archiving Cases

When you're done with a case:
1. Open the case
2. Click **Actions** → **Archive**
3. Archived cases are hidden but can be searched if needed

articles.title: Uploading Files
articles.summary: Learn how to add files to LANA AI
articles.content:
## Uploading Files

Here's how to add files to LANA AI:

### Upload Methods

**Drag and Drop:**
1. Open a case
2. Drag files from your computer
3. Drop them in the upload area

**File Picker:**
1. Click **Upload**
2. Find and select files
3. Click **Open**

**Multiple Files:**
- Select many files at once
- Upload whole folders (desktop app only)

### Supported File Types

- **Documents:** PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Text files (TXT, RTF)
- **Spreadsheets:** Excel (XLSX, XLS), CSV
- **Presentations:** PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT)
- **Images:** PNG, JPG - LANA AI can read text from pictures
- **Zip Files:** Upload a zip and it opens automatically

### What Happens After Upload

LANA AI processes your files:

1. **Reads the text** - Even from pictures and scanned papers
2. **Breaks it into sections** - Like chapters in a book
3. **Creates a memory of it** - So the AI can find it later
4. **Makes it searchable** - So you can ask questions about it

**How Long It Takes:**
- Small files (under 10 pages): A few seconds
- Medium files (10-100 pages): 1-3 minutes
- Large files (over 100 pages): 5-10 minutes

Scanned PDFs take longer because LANA AI has to read the words from the picture.

### Upload Limits

- **Max file size:** 100 MB per file
- **Total storage:** Depends on your plan

### If Upload Fails

**Check:**
- File isn't too big
- File type is supported
- Internet connection is working

**Still not working?**
- Big files take longer
- Many people uploading at once slows it down
- Check the System Status page
- Ask your administrator

articles.title: Connecting to Other Systems
articles.summary: Sync files from SharePoint, Google Drive, and more
articles.content:
## Connecting to Other Systems

LANA AI can automatically get files from other systems.

### Available Connections

**Ready to Use:**
- Microsoft SharePoint
- Google Drive

**Coming Soon:**
- OneDrive
- Dropbox
- Box

Red Rooster Technologies adds new connections regularly. Check the Data Connectors page to see what's available.

### Setting Up a Connection

1. Click **Data Connectors**
2. Click **Install Connector**
3. Pick the system you want to connect
4. Click **Authorize**
5. Sign in to that system (SharePoint, Google Drive, etc.)
6. Give LANA AI permission to read your files
7. Choose settings:
   - Which folders to sync
   - How often to check for new files (hourly, daily, weekly)
   - Which case to put files in
8. Click **Save**

### Authorization Process

When you authorize:
- You'll go to the other system's website
- Sign in with your account
- Give LANA AI permission to read files (read-only)
- You'll come back to LANA AI

**Security:**
- Your login info is encrypted and stored safely
- Connections expire after 2-3 months and need to be renewed
- LANA AI only gets read access (can't delete or change files)

### How Syncing Works

When LANA AI syncs:
1. Checks for new or changed files
2. Downloads them to your LANA AI computer
3. Processes them (reads text, makes searchable)
4. Makes them available for the AI to use

### Checking Sync Status

See how it's working:
- Click **Sync Status** to see all connections
- Check when it last synced
- See how many files it processed
- View any errors

### If Sync Isn't Working

**Try:**
- Re-authorize the connection (it might have expired)
- Check you have access to those folders
- Make sure the LANA AI computer can reach the internet
- Check if the other system is having problems

**Still not working?**
- Look at error details in Sync Status
- Ask your administrator for help

articles.title: Can't Log In?
articles.content:
## Login Problems

Here's how to fix common login issues:

### Wrong Password

1. Make sure Caps Lock is off
2. Try typing your password in a text editor first, then copy and paste it
3. Click **Forgot Password** to reset it

### Account Locked

After 5 wrong password attempts, your account locks for 15 minutes.

**To unlock:**
- Wait 15 minutes
- Or ask your administrator to unlock it

### Email Not Found

- Check you're using the right email
- Look for typos
- Ask your admin if your account exists

### Two-Step Login Issues

**Not getting the code:**
- Check your spam folder
- Make sure your phone number is correct
- Use backup codes from Settings

**Code not working:**
- Make sure your phone's time is correct
- Try generating new codes in Settings

### Desktop App Issues

**Can't find LANA AI computer:**
1. Check you're on the office network
2. Try entering the computer address manually (ask your IT person)
3. Check if firewall is blocking it
4. Restart the app

**App won't open:**
- Clear app data and try again
- Reinstall the app
- Make sure your computer meets requirements

### Network Problems

**Can't reach the server:**
- Check you're on the right network
- Connect to VPN if working remotely
- Ask IT if firewall is blocking you

### Still Can't Log In?

Contact your administrator with:
- Your email address
- Screenshot of the error
- What device and app you're using

articles.title: Slow Performance
articles.content:
## Making LANA AI Faster

If LANA AI is running slowly, try these fixes:

### Check Your Network

**Test speed:**
1. Open System Status page
2. Check connection speed to server
3. Good: under 50ms, OK: under 200ms, Slow: over 500ms

**Improve speed:**
- Use a network cable instead of WiFi
- Make sure you're on the same network as the LANA AI computer
- Close other programs using internet (video streaming, downloads)

### Desktop App Optimization

**Close extra programs:**
- Each open program uses memory
- Keep only what you need open

**Clear app data:**
1. App settings → Privacy
2. Clear cached files
3. Stay logged in to keep your cookies

**Update the app:**
- Use the latest version
- Newer versions work better

### Computer Resources

**Check memory:**
- LANA AI works best with 8GB+ RAM
- Close memory-heavy programs

**Check processor:**
- Background programs might be slowing you down
- Restart if your computer has been on for days

### Server Load

**Check server status:**
- Go to Admin → System Health
- High usage might slow responses

**Peak times:**
- Slower when many people are using it
- Try uploading big files during off-hours

### Big Files

**Processing time:**
- 100+ page PDFs take longer
- Scanned documents need extra processing
- Be patient during uploads

**Make it faster:**
- Split very big files into smaller ones
- Use PDFs with searchable text instead of scanned images

### AI Response Time

**Chat delays:**
- Complex questions take 30-60 seconds (normal)
- Many files take longer to search
- Responses stream in real-time

**Speed up responses:**
- Be specific in your questions
- Use the file drawer to pick specific files
- Choose the right case to limit search

### Still Slow?

- Note which actions are slow
- Check System Health page
- Tell your administrator what's happening

articles.title: Connection Problems
articles.summary: Fix syncing issues with SharePoint and Google Drive
articles.content:
## Fixing Connection Problems

When connections to SharePoint or Google Drive fail:

### Check Sync Status

1. Click **Sync Status**
2. Find your connection
3. Read the error message

### Common Errors

**"Connection expired"**
- Connections expire after 2-3 months
- **Fix:** Re-authorize
  1. Click Data Connectors
  2. Click **Re-authorize**
  3. Sign in again

**"Permission denied"**
- LANA AI can't access the folder
- **Fix:** Check access
  1. Make sure you can see that folder
  2. Check if folder sharing is turned on
  3. Sign in with an account that has access

**"Network error"**
- Can't reach the other system
- **Fix:**
  1. Check internet connection
  2. See if the other system is working
  3. Check firewall settings
  4. Try syncing manually

**"Too many requests"**
- Too many API calls
- **Fix:** Wait and try again
  - Most systems reset limits every hour
  - Reduce how often you sync if this keeps happening

**"Invalid settings"**
- Connection settings are wrong
- **Fix:**
  1. Edit connection settings
  2. Check folder paths are correct
  3. Save again

### Manual Sync

Force a sync right now:
1. Click Sync Status
2. Find the connection
3. Click **Sync Now**
4. Watch it run

### Sync History

See what happened:
1. Click connection name in Sync Status
2. View the log
3. Look for:
   - Files processed
   - Files added
   - Files updated
   - Error messages

### Start Over

If nothing else works:
1. Delete the connection
2. Create a new one
3. Re-authorize
4. Set up settings again

### System-Specific Issues

**SharePoint:**
- Make sure you have site access
- Check library permissions
- See if library is locked

**Google Drive:**
- Check your Google account access
- Files in "Shared with me" need different permissions
- Make sure Drive API is enabled

### Still Not Working?

- Export sync logs
- Take screenshots of errors
- Note which connection and settings
- Contact your administrator or Red Rooster Technologies support

articles.title: Managing Users
articles.content:
## Managing Users

As an admin, you can manage user accounts.

### Adding Users

1. Click **Admin → Users**
2. Click **Add User**
3. Fill in:
   - Email (they'll use this to log in)
   - First and last name
   - Role (see Roles section)
   - Status (active, pending, suspended)
4. Click **Create**
5. User gets an invitation email

### User Roles

- **System Admin** - Can do everything, manage all settings
- **Org Admin** - Can manage users and see all cases in their organization
- **Manager** - Can create cases and assign team members
- **User** - Standard role, can create cases and upload files
- **Viewer** - Can only look, not make changes

### Changing Users

1. Find the user
2. Click **Edit**
3. Change what you need
4. Click **Save**

### Suspending Users

**To temporarily disable access:**
1. Edit user
2. Set status to **Suspended**
3. User can't log in
4. Their data stays safe

**To reactivate:**
1. Edit user
2. Set status to **Active**

### Deleting Users

⚠️ **Warning:** This removes the user permanently.

1. Edit user
2. Click **Delete User**
3. Confirm deletion
4. Their cases and files are kept

### Resetting Passwords

Help users who forgot passwords:
1. Find user
2. Click **Actions → Reset Password**
3. Choose:
   - **Email reset link** (if email is set up)
   - **Set temporary password** (give it to the user)
4. User must change password on next login

### Adding Many Users at Once

**Import from spreadsheet:**
1. Make a CSV file with: email, firstName, lastName, role
2. Click **Import Users**
3. Upload CSV
4. Review and confirm

**Export users:**
1. Click **Export Users**
2. Download CSV
3. Has all user information

### User Limits

Your plan includes a maximum number of users. To add more:
- Contact Red Rooster Technologies
- Upgrade your plan

### Best Practices

- **Give appropriate roles** - Don't give unnecessary access
- **Review regularly** - Check user list every 3 months
- **Remove old accounts** - Suspend or delete unused accounts
- **Use consistent emails** - Same format for everyone (@company.com)
- **Have an onboarding process** - Checklist for new users

articles.title: Roles & Permissions
articles.content:
## Roles & Permissions

LANA AI uses roles to control what people can do.

### Default Roles

**System Admin:**
- Can do everything
- Manage all users and organizations
- Change system settings
- See audit logs
- Access all cases

**Org Admin:**
- Manage users in their organization
- Change organization settings
- See organization statistics
- Access all cases in organization

**Manager:**
- Create and manage cases
- Assign users to cases
- See team activity
- Upload and manage files

**User:**
- Create personal cases
- Upload files to assigned cases
- Use chat and AI features
- See own activity

**Viewer:**
- Read-only access
- View assigned cases
- Cannot create, edit, or delete

### Creating Custom Roles

1. Click **Admin → Roles**
2. Click **Create Role**
3. Name it
4. Pick permissions (see list below)
5. Click **Save**

**Available Permissions:**
- View cases
- Create/edit cases
- Delete cases
- View files
- Upload files
- Delete files
- Use AI chat
- Access admin panel
- View users
- Manage users
- View settings
- Change settings
- View connections
- Manage connections
- View workflows
- Create workflows
- Run workflows

### Assigning Roles

**To one user:**
1. Edit user
2. Pick role from dropdown
3. Save

**To many users:**
1. Select multiple users
2. Click **Bulk Actions → Change Role**
3. Pick new role
4. Confirm

### Case-Level Access

You can also give access to specific cases:

1. Open case
2. Click **Permissions** tab
3. Click **Add User**
4. Pick user and permission level:
   - **Owner** - Full control
   - **Editor** - Can edit and upload
   - **Viewer** - Read-only
5. Save

### How Permissions Work Together

- Org Admins automatically access all cases
- System Admins access everything
- Users only see cases they're assigned to

### Checking Permissions

See who has access:
1. Click **Admin → Audit Logs**
2. Filter by "permission changes"
3. See all role and access changes

### Best Practices

- **Give minimum access needed** - Don't give more than necessary
- **Review regularly** - Check permissions every 3 months
- **Document custom roles** - Keep notes on what each role does
- **Test changes** - Make sure permissions work correctly
- **Use case permissions** - For sensitive cases, control access explicitly
